Who we are

Connecting Ethiopian talent with global opportunity

Horizon Skills & Global Careers is a proposed professional training and international employment facilitation organization focused on preparing job seekers for legitimate overseas opportunities.

Preparation that puts people first.

We aim to help job seekers understand employer expectations, strengthen practical competencies and navigate recruitment processes with clear information at every stage.

Our operating model is intended to work in coordination with the relevant Ethiopian government institutions, including the Ministry of Labour and Skills, subject to applicable approvals, licensing and agreements.

Discover our services

Our commitment

International employment should be built on informed choices, verified opportunities and respect for every worker.

  • Clear information about roles, contracts and conditions
  • Training aligned with relevant job requirements
  • Transparent fees and recruitment procedures
  • Respect for applicable laws and worker protections
  • No guarantee of employment, visa approval or placement
What we do

Skills development and career preparation

Structured support designed to help registered candidates become better prepared for international workplaces.

International pathways

Preparing for opportunities across borders

We intend to develop employer relationships and recruitment pathways in selected markets, based on verified demand, legal requirements and candidate suitability. Click a country to see the focus sectors and requirements for that pathway.

Destination markets and occupations are indicative areas of interest, not confirmation of current vacancies or active recruitment agreements. Actual opportunities depend on employer demand, licensing, immigration rules and applicable bilateral arrangements.

Focus sectors

  • Nursing & elderly care
  • Skilled crafts & trades
  • Logistics & warehousing

Our principles

Professional standards. Responsible recruitment.

Trust is earned through clear processes, accountability and respect for the people we serve.

Legal complianceOperate only within the scope of valid licences, approvals and applicable laws.
TransparencyExplain training, costs, job terms and recruitment steps before candidates commit.
Worker protectionPromote safe work, fair treatment and access to understandable contracts.
Quality trainingUse qualified trainers, relevant curricula and credible assessment methods.
